objective: Build BUKLOD Market Phase 1+2 as one BUKLOD-authenticated digital palengke: buyer discovery, personal/business storefronts, listings, store management, Connect seller inquiry and Public Wall cross-posting without a second social feed or economy authority.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified repository main source SHA 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 on 2026-11-20: Market route is an integration-ready placeholder; canonical public Wall and Connect route exist. This is source-only evidence; exact installed production runtime, current RC, ad fill, and real-device behavior were not verified. Market schema is not applied to live backend in this DEV branch.
chosenApproach: Keep the existing BUKLOD Main route and use shared Auth/Connect/Public Wall. Add isolated Market tables + owner RLS, bounded public product images, atomic server-mediated Wall promotions and lightweight markers/cards. No native modules, new Expo runtime or reward changes.
selectionRationale: Smaller than a second marketplace application or replacing the Wall feed; avoids duplicate auth, unreviewed payment paths, large media, and changes to existing organization authorization.
alternativeApproaches: Build a standalone marketplace with a duplicate identity stack: rejected due to unnecessary sign-in, integration and deployment complexity
Store listings directly as community posts and reuse social post data: rejected because product state, seller authorization, search and stock require independent lifecycle
Launch payments, orders and delivery immediately: rejected pending financial, refund, dispute and regulatory contracts
acceptanceChecks: Any signed-in user can browse/search published active listings, sellers can register a personal/business storefront without changing their BUKLOD identity
Only the actual store owner can create/edit/list/share; hidden/unpublished content is not shown to other users
Seller can compress/upload product photo, recover draft after failed publish, mark sold-out or unpublish
Buyer opens a listing and starts existing Connect personal chat with the actual seller, no duplicate chat engine
Seller shares published listing through canonical Public Wall RPC with 10-minute and 5/day rate limits; the Wall shows linked current status
Market markers are not visible in public Wall captions; ordinary posts preserve media, ads, scrolling and reactions
Node regression tests, database authorization contract, TypeScript, staging installed-client checks required before RC or OTA
preserveBehaviors: Public Wall feed/media/ads render path and existing user social post reward rules remain unchanged; only a small Market-specific link card is additive
Existing Connect chat flow, home/drawer navigation, profile, and organization permission gates for other Focus Apps remain intact
Existing public/scope post rows, account isolation, security and Supabase storage buckets are not modified
No payments, rewards, referrals or native runtime packages are introduced
